versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill to find, shortlist, and research US-based professional-services firms (B2B) using the ServiceGraph API.
- Supports discovery, search, filtering, and enrichment of firms across 22 industries such as law, marketing, IT services, consulting, and more.
- Allows structured queries with advanced filter DSL for fine-grained control by service, location, size, and other attributes.
- Handles credential security by keeping tokens out of the chat context; prompts users to configure keys securely on authorization failures.
- Excludes consumer services, non-US firms, individual freelancers, recruiting, and general web research outside structured B2B service firm needs.
